description: Test script for verifying configurations of Claude Haiku 4.5 models in Bedrock environment, including loading model settings from JSON, asserting provider types, capabilities, token limits, and comparisons with related models.

methods.name: test_bedrock_haiku_4_5_configuration()
methods.description: Verifies that all specified Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5 models use 'bedrock_converse' provider and meet other property requirements.

methods.name: test_bedrock_haiku_4_5_matches_sonnet_capabilities()
methods.description: Checks that Haiku 4.5 has the same capabilities as Sonnet 4.5, including vision, computer use, tools, and token system prompts.

methods.name: test_anthropic_api_haiku_4_5_configuration()
methods.description: Verifies that Anthropic API Claude Haiku 4.5 models are configured correctly, with 'anthropic' provider and appropriate capabilities.
